name: Health Data

meta.description: Read-only access to the current user's own health data (Garmin, Wyze scale, food log, calendar context) with deterministic statistics over any date range: reports against baselines, summaries, trends, period comparisons, correlations. Connects to the user's own database as a read-only Postgres role; it cannot change anything.
